_help: Hand-written overrides keyed by repo name. description/title/live all optional. Set hidden:true to drop a repo; links adds extra buttons.

dwrandomizer.title: Dragon Warrior Randomizer (fork)
dwrandomizer.description: My fork of the Dragon Warrior Randomizer for NES, with extra features.

dwr-tracker.title: DWR Tracker
dwr-tracker.description: Item and progress tracker for Dragon Warrior Randomizer runs.

NES-Custom-Music-Tool.title: NES Custom Music Tool
NES-Custom-Music-Tool.description: Help turn NSF files into custom music files you can use with ZORA (Z1R) and Z2R.

fceux-now-playing.title: FCEUX Now Playing
fceux-now-playing.description: Shows the name of the custom music playing in ZORA and Z2R randomizer ROMs, on screen in FCEUX and as a text file for OBS.

z2r-stream-overlay.title: Z2R Stream Overlay
z2r-stream-overlay.description: Stream overlay for Zelda II Randomizer races and runs.

zelda2-tracker.title: Zelda II Randomizer Tracker
zelda2-tracker.description: Item tracker for Zelda II Randomizer.

ZoraTracker.title: ZORATracker
ZoraTracker.description: Tracker for ZORA seeds (zora.gg), with lots of quality-of-life upgrades.
